_readme: Real construction photographs for evaluating the site-photo bridge.
IMAGES ARE NOT COMMITTED. scripts/fetch_eval_photos.py downloads them to
tests/fixtures/photos/ (gitignored) using the Wikimedia Commons API, which
also re-reads the licence at fetch time so this file cannot drift from the
source. Every entry is public domain / CC0 / CC BY / CC BY-SA.
'contains' is a human description of the photograph, written before the
detector was run on it. 'expect' names the vocabulary prompts a correct
detector would fire on - it is the yardstick, not an assertion about output.

photos.title: File:Detail of vertical crack in concrete retaining wall at Medway Park Sports Centre, Gillingham, Kent, England.jpg
photos.contains: Close, well-lit detail of a vertical crack running through a cast concrete retaining wall.

photos.title: File:Concrete wall cracking as its steel reinforcing cracks and swells 9061.jpg
photos.contains: Concrete wall cracked along the line of corroding reinforcement; rust staining visible at the crack.

photos.title: File:Concrete wall cracking as steel reinforcing corrodes and swells 9058.jpg
photos.contains: Second view of the same failure mode - spalled concrete face with corroding reinforcement behind.

photos.title: File:Concrete honeycomb on ring beam.jpg
photos.contains: Honeycombing on a cast in-situ ring beam - voids where mortar failed to fill around coarse aggregate.

photos.title: File:Honeycomb concrete 202406.jpg
photos.contains: Honeycombed concrete surface, aggregate exposed across a large area of the pour.

photos.title: File:Broken concrete parking chock with exposed rebar.jpg
photos.contains: Broken precast parking chock with reinforcement bar exposed and rusting at the fracture.
Bundles of reinforcement bar stacked on a metro construction site - stored material, not exposed rebar in a member.
photos.note: Deliberate edge case: rebar present but as stored stock. Either firing or not firing is defensible; recorded to see which.

photos.title: File:DETAIL VIEW OF BUTTRESS 4 SHOWING THE RESULTS OF POOR CONSTRUCTION WORK. THOUGH NOT A SERIOUS STRUCTURAL DEFICIENCY, THE 'HONEYCOMB' TEXTURE OF THE CONCRETE SURFACE WAS THE HAER CAL,10-HUME,1-13.tif
photos.contains: Archival monochrome large-format survey photograph of a honeycombed concrete buttress face.
photos.hard_because: Monochrome archival scan. Detector trained on modern colour photography; greyscale film grain is far outside that distribution.

photos.title: File:Crane and the Millennium Tower (301 Mission Street) construction site, SF.JPG
photos.contains: Tower crane photographed at distance against a city skyline; the crane occupies a small part of the frame.
photos.hard_because: Distant subject. The crane is thin structure against sky, small in frame - the classic small-object recall problem.

photos.title: File:EFTA00002592 - Damaged wall with exposed concrete and peeling paint revealing a dark unfinished interior space.jpg
photos.contains: Damaged wall opening into a dark unfinished interior; exposed concrete and peeling paint in poor light.
photos.hard_because: Poor light and heavy occlusion - the defect surfaces are partly in shadow behind a dark opening.
